scope: B4 playable district coverage: MainLevel + one requested main-world level, original character, full-resolution heightfield and per-district AABB collision proxy. Preview population/combat are loaded only for ResidentialArea1. Spawn is the district bounds centre on terrain, not an original PlayerStart.

cases.note: Executes the recovered 17-package/12-step startup chain before playable assembly; movement probe passed.

checks.assembly: MainLevel + requested district; terrain heightfield and collision proxy built for the selected levels; 0 asset/texture failures in every case
checks.spawn: District bounds centre searched outward in 3 m rings up to 30 m for a terrain point outside the static AABB proxies.
checks.population: preview citizens/vehicles/props and combat targets are ResidentialArea1-only; other districts have no population AI
checks.camera: third-person follow; AABB camera pull-in enabled
checks.startupPlayable: ?view=play&startup=1 executes OriginalStreaming 17-package/12-step startup, then builds the all-level AABB collision set, spawns the original character at ResidentialArea1 and runs the B1 movement probe (walk/jump/fly/E-Q) successfully; 8,824 source objects, 144 terrain, 0 failures.
checks.walkableSurfaces: 29 recovered /Mesh/Floor/ AABB tops are sampled in addition to the Landscape heightfield; ?at=<x,z>&yaw=<rad> can place the player on a recovered brick/plaza floor (CommercialArea 100,234 captured, 0 failures). Side collision/PhysX remains absent.
checks.startPlazaCandidate: MainLevel with startup=1 at (20,0) yaw 0 shows a classical-facade/balustrade/billboard city composition closer to the original start plaza than CommercialArea, but the ground is grass, camera/benches are not matched, and it is candidate-only.
checks.floorOverlay: floors=overlay draws the authored GroundBrick_B_A texture over recovered MI_GroundBrick AABB tops as an explicit preview fallback; it is not the original floor mesh rendering and is not default.
checks.plazaPreset: ?view=play&plaza=1 executes startup=1, spawns MainLevel (20,0) yaw 0 with native materialized floors and local trees; preview/candidate only
checks.plazaPoses: MainLevel startup poses: (20,0) open plaza with benches/trees/native paving (current default); (-20,0) nearer fountain/right balustrade; (-30,-4,exact=1) left balustrade/planter/trees. None is a matched camera.
checks.cameraClearSpawn: Spawn search now rejects points whose 4 m rear camera slot intersects static AABBs; plaza=1&at=-20,0&yaw=0 yields a clean balustrade-left/classical-building composition.
checks.questAreas: ?quests=1 renders 21 recovered triggers, marks a nearby trigger as discovered (HUD 1/21 verified at MatQuest_BP2_368) and shows an F detail hint; quest logic/state/rewards are not recovered.
checks.trafficMarkers: ?traffic=1 renders 227 recovered CrossWalk rings and a nearest-crosswalk HUD distance (4.3 m verified at -36.9,-201.1 yaw 0.785); 339 TrafficLight mesh positions are exported; signal timing/BP_TrafficSystem remains unrecovered.
checks.startupOverlay: startup=1/plaza=1 automatically draw the authored GroundBrick_B_A overlay over recovered brick-floor AABBs; floors=native disables it. Verified startup=1 at (20,0). Still a preview fallback, not repaired original floor mesh.
checks.nativeFloors: SM_Floor12000x15000, Bench and nearby Tree/Palm thin instances are materialized as regular mesh clones at load; native MI_FloorBrick1 paving and local trees render (CommercialArea play-floor-fixed.jpg, MainLevel play-plaza-trees2.jpg). exact=1 bypasses the safe-spawn search for framing inspection.
checks.cameraProbe: exact=1, arm=<m> and fov=<deg> are inspection-only overrides for same-camera probes; arm=6/fov=80 (play-plaza-arm6b.jpg, comparison-start-plaza-arm6.jpg) is closer in character scale but not a matched camera; default stays 4 m/92°.
checks.homelander: ?skin=homelander loads the user-provided homelander.glb (real mesh/textures/skeleton). Default maps Homelander authored idle/jog/fly/punch/combo clips onto original action names; original skin still uses all 18 original clips. ?retarget=1 is experimental and leaves arm deformities; exact frame-for-frame original retarget is not solved.

limitations: Spawn is a viewer-safe centre point, not the original PlayerStart or story spawn.
DownTown/Park/TitleMenuLevel have no population, vehicles, AI, quests or combat targets.
Collision is an AABB proxy; no cooked PhysX, capsule/skeletal collision or exact landscape triangle collision.
No same-camera pixel comparison with the original game; these are browser coverage checks.
Static reference-pose skeletal citizens remain hidden in MainLevel batches.
Startup playable mode is a headless verification; 36 FPS is not a performance guarantee and has no original-game matched-camera comparison.
